tax.text: Moore voted for a bill that made tax cuts permanent and reduced taxes on tips, overtime, and Social Security payments.
tax.quote: It delivers the largest tax cut in American history by making the 2017 tax cuts permanent, eliminates tax on tips and overtime, and slashes taxes on Social Security payments.

trade.text: Moore introduced a bill to let the president retaliate against countries imposing high tariffs or other trade barriers.
trade.quote: For them, President Trump’s tariffs marked the end of America’s economic surrender and offered hope that someone in Washington finally cared about bringing honest, blue-collar jobs back to the heartland.

schools.text: Moore says he fought for West Virginia’s Hope Scholarship and supports school choice.
schools.quote: A zip code should not determine a child’s future. I have fought and won for school choice here in West Virginia.

immigration.text: Moore called for completing the border wall, empowering law enforcement to return undocumented immigrants, and reducing illegal immigration to zero.
immigration.quote: When I get to Congress I will work with President Trump to finish the border wall and empower law enforcement with the authority necessary to send illegal immigrants back.

guns.text: Moore supported legislation to prevent financial institutions from tracking firearm and ammunition purchases.
guns.quote: Americans should never have their lawful firearm purchases tracked by financial institutions or payment processors.

abortion.text: His campaign platform says he has a pro-life voting record and will work to end abortion.
abortion.quote: I believe in life from the moment of conception to the moment of natural death.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Moore said he filed a brief defending West Virginia’s law keeping men out of girls’ and women’s sports.
gender.quote: I filed an amicus brief with SCOTUS to defend West Virginia’s law keeping men out of girls’ and women’s sports.

energy.text: Moore said he would support West Virginia’s coal and gas industries and oppose efforts to shut them down.
energy.quote: I will stand up for our coal and gas industries in West Virginia, as I have as your State Treasurer.

voting.text: Moore voted for the SAVE Act, which requires proof of citizenship to register to vote and removal of noncitizens from voter rolls.
voting.quote: Moore voted “Yes” on the legislation, which requires proof of citizenship when registering to vote and requires states to remove non-citizens currently on their voter rolls.

wages.text: He supports raising the minimum wage and strengthening workers’ ability to organize and bargain collectively.
wages.quote: Raise the minimum wage to a living wage

trade.text: He would end current tariffs but says tariffs can be used to level the economic playing field.
trade.quote: Tariffs should be used to level the economic playing field.

debt.text: He supports shoring up Social Security by requiring billionaires to contribute more to the program.
debt.quote: work to shore up Social Security by ensuring that a billionaire and the middle class worker they hire who contributed to them becoming a billionaire aren’t paying the same amount

housing.text: He proposes zoning reform and tax incentives to increase housing supply.
housing.quote: Housing: Tax incentives and zoning reform to build more housing so West Virginians can afford to stay in West Virginia

schools.text: He supports increasing funding for rural public schools and redirecting voucher funds back to public schools.
schools.quote: Increase Title I funds for at-risk rural schools; fund community colleges and trade schools and redirect lost funds for vouchers back into public schools

safety.text: He supports funding community police departments and also investing in social workers and evidence-based addiction recovery.
safety.quote: We need to fund social workers and resources to help people recovering a sense of community and support.

guns.text: He supports lawful gun ownership and says enforcement should focus on illegal activity rather than law-abiding gun owners.
guns.quote: Protect lawful ownership while promoting responsible use and community safety

health.text: He supports universal health care and a single-payer public option, as well as funding rural hospitals.
health.quote: Healthcare: Fund rural hospitals; pursue a single-payer public option

energy.text: He proposes diversifying energy sources, including wind and solar, to lower heating bills.
energy.quote: Energy: Diversify supply through wind, solar, and other sources to drive down heating bills
